upstream.revisionPolicy: Evaluation is pinned to this exact material commit. Later Harbor main commits do not inherit qualification automatically.

materialChanges: Moves parent execution to local Harbor-controlled execution rather than treating a remote parent as the execution authority.
Consumes acknowledged native artifact copies from local parent storage while explicitly retaining Harbor execution authority.
Changes the parent-to-child artifact handoff boundary and therefore requires provenance, freshness, ownership and cancellation revalidation rather than a source-only compatibility check.
Includes cancellation and dashboard-refresh changes that preserve accessible error details while parent observations are refreshed.

acceptance: Run only fixed non-secret parent/child fixtures and bind Harbor plus fixture revisions exactly.
Prove local parent execution retains Harbor authority and that an artifact copy cannot independently authorize child execution, promotion, publication or credential use.
Bind every copied parent artifact to content digest, parent run identity, producer source revision and acknowledgement event; reject stale, partial, mismatched or unacknowledged copies.
Exercise parent cancellation before copy, during copy and after acknowledgement; child execution must fail closed when the inherited evidence is no longer admissible.
Prove retries do not duplicate parent execution or silently reuse a stale local artifact after source/revision drift.
Preserve the private Dataset credential/LFS boundaries from the predecessor wave; local parent storage must not become a path for credential or private-data propagation into trial environments.
Retain accessible structured error details without treating dashboard freshness or HTTP success as benchmark qualification.
Record rollback to the exact predecessor Harbor evaluation contract.

deduplication.result: material successor: execution authority and parent artifact handoff semantics changed after the private-Dataset boundary wave
